items.statement: The three submitted records preserve the named JY1, JY2 and JY3 identities as neutral singlets and provide a connectivity-preserving optimized geometry plus a minimum validation for each.
items.expected: All three identifiers and states match the public definitions; each has geometry provenance and no imaginary modes or an explicitly diagnosed bounded failure.

items.statement: Internal λh is derived from a documented neutral/cation energy cycle rather than asserted without state energies.
items.expected: The report identifies all energies/states and convention used for each molecule.

items.statement: The calculated HOMO energies are JY1 −5.12 eV, JY2 −5.17 eV and JY3 −5.18 eV.
items.expected: Per-molecule HOMO values reproduce these source values within the declared scoring tolerance.

items.statement: The calculated LUMO energies are JY1 −1.88 eV, JY2 −2.19 eV and JY3 −2.18 eV.
items.expected: Per-molecule LUMO values reproduce these source values within the declared scoring tolerance.

items.statement: The internal hole reorganization energies are JY1 0.191 eV, JY2 0.186 eV and JY3 0.189 eV.
items.expected: Per-molecule λh values reproduce these source values within the declared scoring tolerance.
